subject: Hard crash with dplyr left join

messages.author: 693e8dae13e7c1ad
messages.subject: Hard crash with dplyr left join
parts:
Has anyone else experienced hard crashes with dplyr's left join? This consistently crashes R (3.1.3 and 3.2, Windows 8.1 64-bit):

library(dplyr)
library(nycflights13)
left_join(flights, planes, by="tailnum")


This is so basic I get the feeling I must be doing something wrong. R closes fast enough that I can't read the full error message, but it's saying something about ".rcpp warning handler not found".

I'm using dplyr 0.4.1, the most recent version on CRAN.

messages.author: b756a7daa2c2aa6d
messages.subject: Re: Hard crash with dplyr left join
parts:
That usually means you need to re-install Rcpp.
